title: Совет из больницы  (Advice from the Hospital)

segments.t: Unable to control the kitchen on his own, Lyova calls Chef Barinov at the hospital to report that Senya and Fedya refuse to stop arguing while orders pile up. Barinov tells Lyova to either lock the pair in the walk-in refrigerator or use his head to make them yield to one another.
Федя с синей все время спорит.
Now let's go back through the conversation line by line.
'Chef, hello.' Notice how Russian expresses 'chef' and 'hello' with crisp inflection rather than helper words. Vika answers right away.
'Come on, out with it.' Vika anchors the line on 'let's', while 'let's' completes the thought.
'Hello, Chef.' In Russian, the idea of 'hello' flows naturally into 'chef' without extra filler words.
'How are you doing?' Chef Viktor raises the pitch on 'things' to turn the phrase into a direct spoken question. Vika answers right away.
'And how are things with you?' Russians say 'by me' or 'with us' where English says 'I have' or 'we have', without needing a separate word for 'have'.
'There are problems in my...' Spoken Russian keeps this brisk, leaning on 'there is' and finishing on 'my'.
'In your kitchen.' Chef Viktor brings out the contrast between 'on' and 'your' in a few short words. Vika answers right away.
Федя с синей все время спорит.
'Fedya and Senya are arguing all the time.' The meaning hinges on 'Fedya' working together with 'to argue' in spoken Russian.
'And all the work has ground to a halt.' Notice how Russian expresses 'and' and 'costs' with crisp inflection rather than helper words.
'Viktor Petrovich, what should I do?' Notice how Russian expresses 'Viktor' and 'what is one to do' with crisp inflection rather than helper words. Vika answers right away.
'Lock the two of them in the walk-in fridge.' In Russian, the idea of 'and' flows naturally into 'refrigerator' without extra filler words.
'Then use your brain, Lyova.' Here the Russian phrasing highlights 'then' before landing on 'Lyova'.
'Make them give in to each other.' The grammar packs 'to force' and 'other' into a tight, idiomatic kitchen exchange. Alright, let's hear the whole conversation once more from start to finish.
Федя с синей все время спорит.

That wraps up this scene as desperate to get Senya and Fedya back to work, Lyova calls Chef Barinov in the hospital, who advises him to lock them in the walk-in fridge or trick them into reconciling. Until next time!
